Sign in with a one-time code#

Verse signs you in with a six-digit code sent to your email, or to your phone on WhatsApp. There is no password to remember or reset.

Sign in#

  1. Open verse.ctruh.com/signin (or tap Sign in anywhere on the site).
  2. Choose Email me a code or WhatsApp me a code.
  3. Type your email address, or your mobile number (India, +91, is the default; for other countries pick your country first).
  4. Enter the six-digit code. It works for 10 minutes and for five tries.

If this is the first time we see that address or number, a free account is created for you (with the welcome credits and the 14-day trial with Pro features that new accounts get). If an account already has that verified email or number, you are signed in to it.

You are brought back to what you were doing: after choosing a plan on the pricing page, saving an upload to your account, or opening your library.

Where you stay signed in#

A sign-in lasts 30 days on that browser. Account → Sign-in & security lists every place you are signed in. Sign one out, or choose Sign out everywhere. The same page lets you add a second way to sign in (an email or a mobile number) to an existing account.

Things worth knowing#

  • Codes are single-use. Asking for a new one cancels the old one, and a few requests per hour are allowed per address.
  • If you do not get a WhatsApp code, check the number and country, and that WhatsApp is installed on that phone. Email is always an alternative.
  • Plug-ins and the API do not use codes. They keep using an access token from Studio, and the sign-in page has a small "Use an access token" link for people who already have one. See the API reference.

Trouble? Write to hello@ctruh.com with the address you used (never the code).
